description: Simulation Parameters of the Revised T30-2D33 System for Power System Restoration is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Hongfei Yu. "This dataset serves as the supplementary material for a research paper. It contains the detailed topological structure and parameter settings of the \"Revised T30-2D33 System,\" which integrates a modified IEEE 30-bus transmission system with two IEEE 33-bus active distribution networks (ADNs).The provided document (Appendix.pdf) includes: System Topology: A detailed diagram of the T30-2D33 test system ... Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
